name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme as the default for Excava’s interface. It cuts eye strain in low light and keeps focus on the data by reducing glare—critical for long sessions. The trade-off is that some users may prefer a light theme for daylight readability, but we’ll mitigate this with a one-click high-contrast toggle. This matches Manus’ competitive edge while prioritizing clarity and comfort. The artifact: a dark-themed dashboard with interactive, graph-based visualizations.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail in labs where overhead lights or sun glare hit the screen mid-session—users fumble for a manual toggle while data visibility collapses. A better alternative: default to a high-contrast light theme for daylight readability, but let users opt into a dark theme that auto-switches based on ambient light sensors. Settle it with a live demo: measure task completion time and error rates in both glare and low-light conditions.
